:::{#exr-se-error-sd}
#### Spread of the estimation error

Show that the [standard deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-sd)
of the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error) $\erf{\hparam}$
equals the [standard error](#def-SE) of $\hparam$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-se-error-sd}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Var{\erf{\hparam}}
&= \Var{\hparam - \param}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \Var{\hparam}
&& \text{(subtracting a constant does not change a variance)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Taking square roots of both sides,

$$
\begin{aligned}
  \SD{\erf{\hparam}} &= \SD{\hparam} \\
  &= \SE{\hparam}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
